title: Image Classification
description: A representation for the classified the content-items of type image.

ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the embedding was created (e.g., '2024-10-09T09:29:02Z').

level0_prediction.description: Prediction for level 0 for this image CI.

level1_prediction.description: Prediction for level 1 for this image CI.

level2_predictions.description: List of top-k predictions for level 2 for this image CI, (we will use k=3).

confidence.description: Confidence score of the prediction - if class was assigned through predictions.

pred_number.description: 'Number' of the prediction in the top-3, ie. if it was the first, second or third most probable value. Not applicable if class is inferred from the typology hierarchy.

level3_predictions.description: List of top-k predictions for level 3 for this image CI, (we will use k=3).

confidence.description: Confidence score of the prediction - if class was assigned through predictions.

pred_number.description: 'Number' of the prediction in the top-3, ie. if it was the first, second or third most probable value. Not applicable if class is inferred from the typology hierarchy.
